text:
ash: FYI AcmeEdge opened a ticket: ~20% delta between our marketplace billable units and their ingestion for 2026-03-22 hourly windows. They suspect the ambassador client does sampling (sample_rate ~= 0.8). Can metering look? :eyes:
maria: thanks, moving to triage. Do we have their CSV sample yet?

ash: they uploaded a small excerpt:
```
ts,our_units,partner_units
2026-03-22T10:00Z,120,96
2026-03-22T11:00Z,95,76
```

samir: exact 0.8 multiplier in those rows. Could be device-side sampling or a rollup window mismatch. Did partner say which exporter config they used?

maria: their note: "ambassador default sample_rate=0.8 for constrained devices; rollup=hour". They only noticed because monthly totals breached our threshold.

devin: short-term options: 1) request raw minute-level traces for the disputed windows, 2) run inverse-sample heuristics and propose credits (risky), 3) normalize entitlement mapping to accept partner sample metadata (long-term).

lia: operational ask: if they provide device-consistent ids, I can run a staging rollup to compute per-hour amplification factors and a proposed credit table.

ash: Acme is willing to provide 24h of minute-level traces if we sign a minimal addendum for PII. Legal already flagged the NDA requirement.

samir: recommendation: request raw minute traces + ambassador config, then compute side-by-side: our_rollup vs partner_rollup(simulated sample_rate). Produce per-device multiplier and present it back for signoff. Avoid automatic inverse heuristics until partner confirms.

maria: I'll draft the partner request and attach the redacted-data addendum template.

billing-bot: Invoice discrepancy alert: partner=acmeedge id=AC-9841 window=2026-03-22 status=open severity=high

devin: checklist for the run:
- create staging prefix: s3://partners-staging/acmeedge/repro/1776543333/
- ingest partner CSV + minute traces to staging
- run redwood-rollup --window=hour --source=our-agg
- run partner-rollup --sample-rate=0.8 --window=hour
- diff -> per-device multipliers & audit csv

lia: I can own staging ingestion. samir will own rollup scripts. maria owns comms. ash will coordinate with legal for the addendum.

ash: Acme wants preliminary numbers by EOD PT. Can we hit that?

samir: if upload within 2hrs: staging ~20m, rollups ~40m, diff ~10m. Should be fine. Starting scripts now.

maria: drafting message now and will ask for ambassador config + commit hash for exporter.

lia: kicked off staging prep (job id: staging-1776543333). Will post presigned URLs when ready. :rocket:

ash: thanks team. After recon we can propose either credits or entitlement normalization depending on partner preference. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
